subject.title: feat: model-centric usage & spend view across providers (Scope B from #2257)

question: Should CodexBar accept an initial cross-provider model view that aggregates only trimmed, case-insensitive exact model names and intentionally does not deduplicate overlapping provider sources?
rationale: The branch is a new user-facing aggregation mode, and the linked design discussion identifies canonical identity and double-counting as product semantics rather than a mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Approve the narrow exact-name MVP
options.body: Keep token totals limited to exact normalized names, retain per-currency cost handling, prominently disclose that sources are not deduplicated, and fix the Kimi-only render path before merge.

options.title: Require canonicalization first
options.body: Pause this PR until a provider-aware canonical model identity and an explicit duplicate-source policy are designed and validated.

options.title: Scope down to provider-local models
options.body: Retain model visibility without cross-provider aggregation, deferring merged totals until the canonicalization policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow exact-name MVP
recommendation.body: Keep token totals limited to exact normalized names, retain per-currency cost handling, prominently disclose that sources are not deduplicated, and fix the Kimi-only render path before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining blocker is product acceptance of a new dashboard aggregation contract, not a contributor-specific implementation choice.
